workflows.name: Cut a Product Out of Its Background
workflows.description: Remove the background and adjust edge softness without blurring the product. Set edge softness to 0 to keep the original cutout.
workflows.sourceId: nodetool-base/Cut a Product Out of Its Background

data.comment:
# Cut a Product Out of Its Background

Removes the background from a product photo and softens only the cutout edge, so the product stays sharp. Use it to prepare clean PNGs for listings.

**How it works:** "Photo" goes into "Remove background". "Soften cutout edge" blurs that result by the "Edge softness" radius, and "Keep product detail" uses the blurred copy only as the alpha channel over the unblurred cutout. "Save finished PNG" writes the file to the workspace and "Result" shows it.

**Try this:** Set "Edge softness" to 0 for the original hard cutout, or raise it toward 3 for a softer edge on hair or fabric.

data.name: edge_softness
data.description: Edge softness in pixels. Set to 0 for the original cutout.

workflows.name: Put a Product on a Studio Backdrop
workflows.description: Remove the background, soften the cutout edge, and place the product in a new studio scene.
workflows.sourceId: nodetool-base/Put a Product on a Studio Backdrop

data.comment:
# Put a Product on a Studio Backdrop

Cuts a product out of its photo and places it in a new studio scene. Use it to restyle product shots without a reshoot.

**How it works:** "Photo" goes to "Cut out", which removes the background. "Soften cutout edge" blurs the mask by the "Edge softness" value, and "Keep product detail" puts that softer mask back on the product. "Place on backdrop" generates a concrete plinth scene around it, and "Result" shows the image.

**Try this:** Pick a model on "Place on backdrop", then change its prompt to "white marble countertop, morning window light".

data.prompt: Keep the product as it is. Change only what is around it: warm concrete plinth, soft studio key from upper left, blurred background.

data.name: edge_softness
data.description: Edge softness in pixels. Set to 0 for the original cutout.

workflows.name: Relight a Product for a Seasonal Campaign
workflows.description: Same product, different season, no reshoot. Relighting keeps the geometry and materials and changes only where the light comes from.
workflows.sourceId: nodetool-base/Relight a Product for a Seasonal Campaign

data.comment:
# Relight a Product for a Seasonal Campaign

Changes the lighting on an existing product photo so it fits a new season without a reshoot. The product's shape and materials stay as they are.

**How it works:** "Photo" takes the image you upload. "Relight" sends it to a relighting model with a prompt that describes the new light source, and "Result" shows the relit photo.

**Try this:** Pick a model on "Relight", then swap the prompt for "cool morning light from behind, pale blue haze" to get a spring look.

data.prompt: warm low winter sun from the left, long soft shadows

workflows.name: Spin a Packshot into a Turntable Clip
workflows.description: A still becomes motion for the product page. Image-to-video keeps the product identical and adds only the camera move, which a text-to-video model would not.
workflows.sourceId: nodetool-base/Spin a Packshot into a Turntable Clip

data.comment:
# Spin a Packshot into a Turntable Clip

Turns a product still into a short orbiting clip for a product page. Image-to-video keeps the product as photographed and adds only the camera move.

**How it works:** "Packshot" takes your product photo. "Animate" generates a 4-second square clip at 720p from a prompt for a slow orbit with fixed lighting, and "Clip" returns it.

**Try this:** Pick a model on "Animate", then change the prompt to "slow push in toward the label" for a detail shot instead of an orbit.

data.prompt: slow orbit around the product, fixed lighting, product stays centred

workflows.name: Take a Product Shot to Print Resolution
workflows.description: Upscale the approved product photo, then sharpen fine detail with an adjustable, light finishing pass. Set sharpness to 0 to disable it.
workflows.sourceId: nodetool-base/Take a Product Shot to Print Resolution

data.comment:
# Take a Product Shot to Print Resolution

Upscales an approved product photo four times and adds a light sharpening pass for print. The result is saved as a PNG in the workspace.

**How it works:** "Photo" starts with a sample coffee image. "Upscale 4x" enlarges it, then "Sharpen fine detail" applies an unsharp mask whose amount comes from the "Sharpness" input. "Save finished PNG" writes a timestamped file, and "Result" shows it.

**Try this:** Pick a model on "Upscale 4x", then set "Sharpness" to 0 to compare the upscale with no sharpening.

data.name: sharpness
data.description: Sharpening strength. Set to 0 to disable.

workflows.name: Write a Listing from the Product Photo
workflows.description: Hand the model the photograph rather than a description of it. Marketplace copy written from the actual image catches details a spec sheet omits — finish, proportion, what it sits next to.
workflows.sourceId: nodetool-base/Write a Listing from the Product Photo

data.comment:
# Write a Listing from the Product Photo

Writes a marketplace listing from the product photo itself. Working from the image catches details a spec sheet leaves out, such as finish and proportion.

**How it works:** Drop the photo into "1 Photo". "2 Copywriter" looks at it and writes a title under 70 characters and a description of about 80 words, without superlatives or invented specs. "3 Listing" returns the text.

**Try this:** Pick a vision-capable model on "2 Copywriter" and change its prompt to ask for five bullet points instead.

data.system: You write marketplace listings. Lead with the concrete: material, size cues, finish. No superlatives, no invented specifications.
data.prompt: Write a product title under 70 characters and a description of about 80 words for the product in this image.
